note: Every third party piece this edition was built from, archived here so the whole thing can be rebuilt offline from pinned bytes.

archives.role: The foundation this edition is adapted from
excludedFromArchive: img/ (2.8 MB of screenshots and social images for the PaperCSS documentation site, none of which this adaptation uses)
package-lock.json (a 208 KB lockfile for a build pipeline this adaptation does not run)
archives.excludedWhy: Documentation screenshots and build metadata only. Every source file of the library, its dist stylesheet, its licence, its README and its documentation pages are included unchanged; the complete original remains available at the pinned commit above.

archives.role: Draws the hand drawn graphics at build time
archives.note: The bundled ES module from this tarball is vendored directly at tools/vendor/rough.esm.js, so tools/make-art.mjs runs with no install step.

archives.role: The machine readable copy of the Open Peeps artwork
archives.license: MIT for the wrapper code, copyright 2020 to present Emre Cakir. The artwork it carries is Open Peeps by Pablo Stanley, CC0.
archives.note: tools/make-people.mjs unpacks this archive, renders the figures once with react-dom/server, and writes static SVG files into assets/.
assets/bricolage-grotesque.woff2 is files/bricolage-grotesque-latin-wght-normal.woff2 from this tarball, unmodified.

notInSourceZipWhy: Both are large binary npm tarballs whose output already ships inside the archive: the eleven Open Peeps SVG figures and the woff2 file are in assets/, with their licences in licenses/. Each is pinned by version and sha256 above and can be refetched with the npm pack command given. They are kept in full in the Plotform repository at vendor/templates/studio-workshop/upstream/.
